headline: NestJS • React • Next.js • TypeScript • PostgreSQL • MongoDB
summary: Full-stack developer with **5+ years** of experience shipping production SaaS platforms, enterprise ERP systems, multi-sided marketplaces, and AI-powered features end to end — from database design and secure APIs to polished dashboards, mobile-app backends, and Linux deployments. Specialist in **NestJS, React/Next.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL and MongoDB**, with deep hands-on experience in **multi-tenant architecture, RBAC, JWT/OAuth authentication**, payments, and LLM integrations. Progressed from developer to **Team Lead and Director**, and has delivered 10+ projects across the full lifecycle. An **AI-augmented engineer** who uses Claude Code and Claude.ai daily — with custom-built skills and project context — to write, review, and test code faster while keeping quality high. Has shipped multiple platforms that are **live in production today**, spanning admin, vendor, logistics, teacher, driver, and customer apps.

items.label: Code generation
items.text: Use Claude Code as an agentic pair programmer to scaffold NestJS modules, TypeORM entities, DTOs, React/Next.js components and API clients, then refine and own every line — cutting time spent on boilerplate so effort goes into architecture and business logic.

items.label: Custom skills
items.text: Built reusable Claude skills encoding team conventions — NestJS module structure, RBAC/permission checks, multi-tenant query scoping, and API response standards — so generated code is consistent with the codebase from the first draft.

items.label: Code review
items.text: Run AI-assisted reviews on every change to catch logic bugs, missing tenant isolation, insecure auth paths, N+1 queries, and edge cases before human review and merge.

items.label: Testing
items.text: Generate and extend unit, integration, and API tests with Jest for NestJS and Express services using Claude, covering validation rules, permission boundaries, and failure paths; use the agent to reproduce, debug, and fix failing tests.

items.label: Workflow
items.text: Maintain CLAUDE.md project context, connect tools via MCP, and use Claude.ai for system design, schema planning, documentation, and refactoring plans — delivering features faster with fewer regressions.

value-growth-advisory: Delivered a complete **enterprise ERP and delivery-fleet management platform** (admin dashboard + driver mobile app) from architecture to deployment using NestJS, TypeScript, TypeORM, and PostgreSQL.
Built a tutor/education application featuring **7 distinct role-based dashboards** on a shared NestJS API.
Designed **multi-tenant data isolation** at company and branch level, ensuring every query and API action is correctly scoped to the user’s organization.
Implemented **role-based access control (RBAC)** that keeps dashboard navigation and backend permissions in sync, closing gaps between what users see and what they can execute.
Own business-critical modules such as **commissions and fleet operations**, with strict validation and data-consistency rules for financial and operational records.
Use **Claude Code with custom project skills** to generate, review, and test backend modules, accelerating delivery while maintaining code quality and consistent conventions.
Handle production deployment and configuration on AWS/VPS across Linux, Nginx, domains, and SSL.
1-sol-digital-services: Led a **complete UI redesign** and new feature enhancements for a sports multi-tenant web application.
Integrated **LLM-powered features** into production SaaS products, enabling intelligent automation and conversational workflows for end users.
Built a **Copilot-style chat interface** in React and Material UI with real-time streaming responses and dynamic prompt orchestration.
Developed secure backend APIs for AI services, including authentication, token management, and **usage limits to control AI cost**.
Independently developed **two additional production websites** end to end.
grace-technology: **Promoted from Backend Developer to Team Lead of the Web Department**, owning delivery and technical direction for the team.
Delivered **3 projects across the full development lifecycle**, from requirements to production.
Redesigned MongoDB schemas and indexes to speed up slow queries on high-traffic endpoints.
Integrated **Stripe payments**, email automation, SMS services, and third-party APIs.
**Mentored junior developers** and led code reviews, raising code quality and team workflow standards.
uzair-technology: **Progressed from Developer to Backend Team Lead, and ultimately to Director**, taking on technical and organizational leadership.
Successfully delivered **6+ projects** from planning through deployment.
Developed full-stack applications with MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, Node.js, and Laravel.
Built RESTful APIs and backend services with JWT-based authentication and authorization, and optimized database queries and indexes.
